paragraphs.text: Lead Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and leading development of
high-performance, fault-tolerance scalable trading and fintech systems. Proven expertise in Java
backend engineering, distributed systems, and blockchain applications. Experienced team lead and
project manager with a track record of delivering mission-critical financial platforms for global
markets. Eligible to work remotely for U.S. companies from Canada (no visa required for remote).
Senior Software Engineer (Independent Contractor) | Mercor (Remote)
Nov 2025 – Present
Contribute as an independent contractor helping world-leading AI labs train and evaluate advanced models on senior-level software engineering and problem-solving tasks.
Lead Software Developer/Team Leader| GMO-Z.com Fintech CA, Vancouver
Nov 2024 – Sep 2025
Led a backend engineering team delivering trading system for 1M+ clients (one of top 5 on Japanese market), improving scalability and reliability through high-performance
Java components.
Improved system maintainability by raising test coverage by 20% and streamlining documentation, reducing onboarding time for new engineers.
Boosted team productivity by integrating Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Cursor AI) into daily workflows, accelerating prototyping and troubleshooting.
VP / Director of Software Development / Lead Software Developer |
CardinalChain Software Inc, Vancouver
Apr 2019 – Nov 2024
Directed engineering and product development for enterprise-scale crypto trading platforms serving 1M+ users, ensuring reliability and regulatory compliance.
Improved system throughput by 25% by introducing a transactional cache for trading data, significantly reducing database load and latency under high transaction volume.
Mentored and managed a team of developers, improving delivery speed and overall team productivity through better code review practices and agile coordination.
Senior Software Developer | FitechSource Saint Petersburg Ltd.
Nov 2003 – Apr 2019
Developed trading systems for the Japanese financial market, including transaction reliability.
Built a prototype in-memory database (H2 → Oracle replication) that boosted data access speed while maintaining full persistence and consistency.
Built a cached JDBC driver wrapper enabling seamless integration into existing Java systems, reducing database load and data access time.
Developed reusable enterprise Java services as part of xTier middleware, reducing development time and code duplication for multiple internal applications.
Software Engineer | Borland Software AG / Togethersoft Labs Inc, St.
Petersburg
Jan 2001 – Sep 2003
Implemented UML-to-XML import/export using XMI standards, enabling seamless model interoperability for JBuilder and Together IDE.
QA Engineer/Software Developer| ZAO Comita, St. Petersburg
Aug 1999 – Dec 2000
Improved QA process by automating testing for banking and supervisory systems.
M.Sc., Microcomputer & Network Software – St. Petersburg Technical
State University, Russia (1999)
Languages & Frameworks: Java, C#, VBA, Go, Spring, SpringBoot, Maven, Gradle,
Servlets, XML, Python
Databases: MySQL, Oracle, PostrgeSQL, HSQL, Redis, JDBC, NoSql
Systems & Platforms: Tomcat , JBoss, WebLogic, Rabbit MQ, Kafka,
AWS
Tools: Git, BitBucket, Jenkins, Junit, IDEA, Eclipse, Redmine, Jira, Confluence, CI/CD,
Grafana, DataDog, Docker, Kubernetes
Finance & Blockchain: Blockchain (BTC, ETH), Forex, FIX
Emerging Tools: AI-assisted coding (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor AI), ML concepts
(Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow basics)
Other: Leadership and management, high performance fault tolerant distributed
systems, code-review, documentation
